mandatoryCriteria: Invitation listing permissions: Workspace Owner and Project Manager can list invitations for their project
Sensitive token omission: Listed invitations strictly conform to invitationSchema and NEVER expose token_hash or raw token
Status mapping: Past-due pending invitations are dynamically mapped to status expired
Boundary enforcement: Members and viewers cannot list invitations (403 FORBIDDEN); outsiders and sibling project managers receive 404 NOT_FOUND
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: Project invitation listing, pagination, and secret redaction. Out-of-scope: CSV export of invitations.
